# IELTS Speaking Part 2 可复习资料库

这是 Part 2 的成品复习入口，不是素材收集台账。完整原题及中英翻译见 [2026 年 5-8 月 Part 2 题库与素材分类](./2026-may-august-part-2-topic-clusters.md)，详细事实来源见 [Part 2 Knowledge Bank](./part-2-knowledge-bank.md)。

- 覆盖全部 `55` 道题。
- `54` 道题使用真实经历或经可靠来源核对的材料。
- `PE11` 没有真实儿童素材，保留为明确标记的应急合成卡。
- 所有题目目前均为“内容就绪”，尚未完成两分钟口述验证；不能把内容就绪等同于考试就绪。
- 不背整篇答案。先用中文记忆链恢复事实，再用英文表达块组织自己的答案。

## 复习方法

1. 一分钟准备时，只看“关键词”和对应题目的“切换重点”。
2. 口述时按“背景 - 具体场景 - 结果 - 感受”展开，不要求逐字复现英文表达块。
3. 结束后检查“事实边界”，避免把不同时间线、人物角色或完成状态混在一起。

## 快速索引

| 卡片 | 核心素材 | 覆盖题号 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| R01 | 姚顺雨访谈、主动学习与 ChatGPT | EV06、EV08、OB03、OB05、OB08、OB13 |
| R02 | 四人循迹小车项目 | PE06、PE10、EV03、EV05、EV09、EV13、EV14 |
| R03 | Spider-Man 宣传片与朋友观影 | EV01、OB06、OB11 |
| R04 | 二手湖与低成本露营 | EV02、OB09、PL01、PL02、PL04 |
| R05 | 姐姐的两次教育选择 | EV17、EV18 |
| R06 | 仁和新城商业综合体 | PL05、PL07、PL08 |
| R07 | 256 GB 改买 512 GB 手机 | OB10、OB15 |
| R08 | Boston：MIT 项目与 Celtics 比赛 | EV07、EV11、PL06 |
| R09 | Jensen Huang 与长期 AI 抱负 | PE02、PE12、OB02、OB14 |
| R10 | 外向的童年好友 | PE01、PE05、PE08 |
| R11 | 母亲：植物、邻里帮助与环保 | PE03、PE07、PE09 |
| R12 | 姐姐婚礼与粉色多层蛋糕 | EV10、EV12、OB07 |
| R13 | 塑料购物袋有偿使用规定 | OB01 |
| R14 | 曾任儿科医生的父亲 | PE04 |
| R15 | 喜欢画画的孩子 | PE11（应急卡） |
| R16 | 电脑黑屏后重装系统 | EV04 |
| R17 | 《工程与法律》课堂禁用手机 | EV19 |
| R18 | 组织混乱的班级音乐会 | EV15 |
| R19 | 海南自行车环岛计划 | EV16 |
| R20 | 《犟龟》与坚持完成 3D 打印 | OB04 |
| R21 | 想购买的 32 GB MacBook Pro | OB12 |
| R22 | 不想长期居住的朋友公寓 | PL03 |
| R23 | 家中最放松的地方：床 | PL09 |

---

## R01 - 从等待机会到主动行动

**覆盖：** EV06、EV08、OB03、OB05、OB08、OB13

**中文记忆链：** 大三末以前较被动，认为机会主要靠运气 - 6 月在 Bilibili 看约一小时的姚顺雨访谈 - 他从物理本科走向 AI 研究并主动学习、投递简历 - 意识到行动能创造选择 - 改变 IELTS 学习方式，主动用 ChatGPT 练口语、追问、纠错和整理素材 - 固定日计划两天才能完成，于是改成可顺延的优先级计划。

**一分钟关键词：**

> third year → passive → Shunyu Yao interview → physics to AI → keep learning / send CV → take initiative → ChatGPT → speaking practice → flexible priority plan

**英文表达块：**

> I used to believe that good opportunities depended mainly on luck, so I often waited instead of taking action.

> A one-hour interview with research scientist Shunyu Yao changed my view because he kept learning and applying for opportunities rather than waiting for ideal conditions.

> I then began using ChatGPT actively for speaking practice, follow-up questions, corrections, and organising my Part 2 material.

> When one planned day of IELTS work started taking almost two actual days, I replaced the fixed schedule with a flexible, priority-based plan.

**题目切换：**

- **EV06 重要决定：** 突出“不再等待，主动创造选择”。
- **EV08 改变计划：** 突出固定日程过量、任务可顺延、口语优先。
- **OB03 外语学习工具：** 突出实时口语、解释、纠错和主动提取。
- **OB05 网络节目：** 突出 6 月、Bilibili、约一小时、物理转 AI、AI 未来观点。
- **OB08 有趣视频：** 突出“主动学习和投简历”改变了自己的想法。
- **OB13 程序或应用：** 突出 ChatGPT 在电脑或手机上的个性化学习用途。

**事实边界：** 不编造访谈节目名称；不声称新计划已带来最终分数提升。

---

## R02 - 四人循迹小车项目

**覆盖：** PE06、PE10、EV03、EV05、EV09、EV13、EV14

**中文记忆链：** 上学期四人团队从零制作循迹避障小车 - 分工为传感器板、控制板/PID、实验记录、自己的 3D 建模打印与组装 - 负责人制定计划、截止时间和任务 - 两块 PCB 无法连接时提出增加中间接口板 - 控制板布局太紧凑导致多次焊接失败，自己用证据说服队友重做 - 电路延迟压缩测试时间，机械间隙和 PID 调参不足，最终测试没有完全成功 - 学到集成和测试不能留到最后。

**一分钟关键词：**

> last term → four people → line-following car → four roles → my 3D print / assembly → interface board → compact PCB → redesign → delay → little PID testing → final test → integration lesson

**英文表达块：**

> We worked in a four-person team to build a small line-following car, and my main responsibility was designing and 3D-printing the structure and assembling the components.

> When the sensor board and control board could not be connected directly, one teammate suggested adding a small interface board, and the solution worked.

> I also persuaded another teammate to redesign a PCB because its layout was too compact and had caused repeated soldering failures.

> The final test did not fully succeed because circuit delays left too little time for mechanical testing and PID tuning, but it taught me the importance of integration.

**题目切换：**

- **PE06 巧妙解决问题的人：** 只讲提出接口板的项目负责人。
- **PE10 经常制定计划的人：** 讲分工、截止时间、四项任务及遇到新问题后调整方案。
- **EV03 很久才回复消息：** 截止前约六天忙于项目，母亲日常问候几天未回，后来道歉并解释。
- **EV05 技术难题：** 讲电路延迟、低底盘间隙、PID 时间不足和集成失败。
- **EV09 团队合作：** 讲四人分工、相互依赖和最终教训。
- **EV13 劝别人做不愿做的事：** 讲队友因沉没成本拒绝重做 PCB，自己用失败证据说服他。
- **EV14 发挥想象力：** 讲没有现成结构，自己建模、打印、排列和组装部件。

**事实边界：** 整体最终测试没有完全成功；接口板和重新设计控制板分别解决了局部问题。不要把两者说成同一位队友或同一问题。

---

## R03 - Spider-Man 宣传片与朋友观影

**覆盖：** EV01、OB06、OB11

**中文记忆链：** 很久没见朋友 - 都喜欢 Marvel - 6 月在 Bilibili 看到官方宣传片 - Spider-Man 搂着 Messi 荡蛛丝，Messi 表情僵硬，网友调侃演技 - 觉得好笑并更期待电影 - 上映后与朋友约好一起看，自己负责订票 - 看完讨论角色、评分和未来电影 - 借电影重新联系。

**一分钟关键词：**

> long time no see → Marvel fans → June / Bilibili → Messi + Spider-Man → web swinging → stiff expression → funny → booked tickets → cinema → discussion → reconnect

**英文表达块：**

> Since we had not seen each other in ages, we arranged to watch *Spider-Man: Brand New Day* together, and I booked the tickets.

> The funniest promotional scene showed Spider-Man holding Messi while they swung between buildings on a web, and many viewers joked about Messi's stiff expression.

> After the film, we compared our opinions and talked about future Marvel movies, which reminded me how much I had missed spending time with them.

**题目切换：**

- **EV01 组织的开心活动：** 协调观影、负责订票、朋友参加、重新联系。
- **OB06 名人广告：** 只讲 6 月宣传片、Messi、蛛丝摆荡、网友反应和自己的期待。
- **OB11 最近看的电影：** 讲共同兴趣、观影和看完后的讨论。

**事实边界：** Messi 只出现在宣传片中，不能说他出演了电影；不把普通观影编成生日或大型派对。

---

## R04 - 二手湖：环境变化与低成本露营

**覆盖：** EV02、OB09、PL01、PL02、PL04

**中文记忆链：** 家乡附近的二手湖 - 祖父母过去在那里钓鱼 - 以前脏且有异味 - 政府治理和旅游开发后更干净、更适合散步 - 现在和家人去 - 一次与父母自带露营用品和食材，在湖边草地露营 - 因为离家近，总花费约 10 元 - 希望引入更严格的湖边垃圾罚款和生态保护规则。

**一分钟关键词：**

> hometown lake → grandparents fishing → dirty / smell → cleanup → cleaner → family → parents → own camping gear and food → grass by lake → about 10 yuan → litter fines / ecosystem

**英文表达块：**

> Ershou Lake is close to my hometown, and my grandparents used to fish there.

> It used to be dirty and unpleasant, but environmental cleanup gradually made it cleaner and more attractive.

> On one outing, my parents and I brought our own camping supplies and food and camped on the grass beside the lake, so the whole day cost only about ten yuan.

> I would introduce clearer fines for littering around lakes and stronger rules to protect fish and the wider ecosystem.

**题目切换：**

- **EV02 低成本特别外出：** 父母、自带用品和食材、湖边草地、约 10 元。
- **OB09 希望引入的新规定：** 湖边乱扔垃圾罚款、保护鱼类与生态。
- **PL01 重要湖泊：** 家乡、祖父母、环境变化和公共价值。
- **PL02 推荐的国内地点：** 干净、适合家庭散步和放松。
- **PL04 空闲想去的地方：** 和家人散步、清空思绪、缓解学习压力。

**事实边界：** 不声称露营过夜或步行到湖边；地方治理措施不是已确认名称的法律。

---

## R05 - 姐姐的两次教育选择

**覆盖：** EV17、EV18

**中文记忆链：** 事件一：姐姐高考后选大学 - 分数限制选项，也有专业偏好 - 自己和母亲查学校、比专业和利弊 - 建议兼顾现实条件与兴趣。事件二：姐姐后来有稳定工作 - 放弃稳定路径，选择攻读真正想读的研究生 - 她承担不确定性的魄力让自己自豪。

**一分钟关键词：**

> EV17: sister → grades → preferred major → mother and me → research → compare → advice → informed choice

> EV18: stable job → leave security → desired postgraduate degree → uncertainty → courage → proud

**英文表达块：**

> My mother and I helped my sister compare universities and majors based on both her grades and her genuine interests.

> I tried not to make the decision for her; I encouraged her to balance realistic options with what she actually wanted to study.

> Later, she gave up a stable job to pursue the postgraduate degree she genuinely wanted, and I was proud of her courage to leave a secure path.

**题目切换：**

- **EV17 给别人建议：** 使用高考后选大学的事件。
- **EV18 为家人自豪：** 使用放弃稳定工作读研究生的事件。

**事实边界：** 两题是不同时间的事件；不声称她已完成研究生学位或取得未确认的结果。

---

## R06 - 仁和新城：方便但乏味的高层商场

**覆盖：** PL05、PL07、PL08

**中文记忆链：** 家附近的高层商业综合体 - 有服装、咖啡、餐饮、电影院和促销 - 和朋友看电影，和父母喝咖啡 - 每次体验相似、缺少独特活动 - 方便但不令人兴奋 - 高层外观普通且给自己压迫感，让人联想到快节奏与竞争，更喜欢自然、有生活感的独立小房子。

**一分钟关键词：**

> Renhe Xincheng → near home → clothes / coffee / food / cinema → friends / parents → convenient → repetitive → nothing unique → high-rise → oppressive → fast pace / competition

**英文表达块：**

> Renhe Xincheng is a shopping centre near my home with ordinary facilities such as restaurants, coffee shops, clothing stores, and a cinema.

> It is convenient, but every visit feels almost the same and there is nothing particularly distinctive about it.

> I also dislike the oppressive feeling of the high-rise building because it reminds me of fast-paced urban life and competitive pressure.

**题目切换：**

- **PL05 无聊的地方：** 重复、可预测、没有探索欲。
- **PL07 不喜欢的高层建筑：** 压迫感、城市节奏与竞争，和独立小房子对比。
- **PL08 购物中心：** 地点、设施、同行者、日常活动和正反评价。

**事实边界：** 这是个人感受，不能说建筑不安全或设计质量有问题。

---

## R07 - 从 256 GB 改买 512 GB 手机

**覆盖：** OB10、OB15

**中文记忆链：** 以前用 256 GB 经常删不常用 App - 原计划仍买 256 GB - 购买时临时改成 512 GB - 多花约人民币 2,000 元 - 后来不再担心空间，也不用持续删 App - 认为值得 - 手机还承担联系、学习、地图、支付、拍照和日程等功能。

**一分钟关键词：**

> old 256 GB → delete apps → planned 256 GB → changed mind → 512 GB → 2,000 yuan extra → no storage worry → worth it → daily tasks

**英文表达块：**

> I originally planned to buy the 256-gigabyte version, but I changed my mind at the time of purchase and chose 512 gigabytes instead.

> It cost about two thousand yuan more, but I no longer need to delete less frequently used apps or worry about storage.

> I rely on my phone for communication, study, maps, digital payments, photos, and many small everyday tasks.

**题目切换：**

- **OB10 花费超过预期：** 突出容量选择、约 2,000 元价差和为什么值得。
- **OB15 离不开的东西：** 突出高频用途与日常依赖，不要字面声称无法生存。

**事实边界：** 不把相机、性能、配件或使用寿命说成升级原因。

---

## R08 - Boston：MIT 暑期项目与 Celtics 比赛

**覆盖：** EV07、EV11、PL06

**中文记忆链：** 去 Boston 参加 MIT 短期暑期项目 - 用 NeRF 将视频重建为 3D 模型，自己负责平滑噪声和伪影 - 最后一天平时 9 点起、当天 7 点起，协调分工并准备 poster，同题组第二名 - 在 TD Garden 看 Celtics NBA 比赛 - 不记得对手 - 进攻时喊 Go Celtics，防守时喊 Defense - 原以为 Boston 只有学术气氛，后来看到充满活力的一面 - 确认它是去过且最喜欢的城市。

**一分钟关键词：**

> Boston → MIT summer project → NeRF → smooth artifacts → final day 7 a.m. → poster → second place → TD Garden → Celtics → chants → academic + energetic → favourite city

**英文表达块：**

> I went to Boston for a short summer project at MIT, where we used NeRF to reconstruct 3D models from video footage.

> On the final day, I got up at seven instead of my usual nine to coordinate the presentation and prepare our poster, and our group placed second among teams working on the same topic.

> At TD Garden, the crowd cheered for the Celtics on offence and repeatedly shouted "Defense!" when the other team had the ball.

> The contrast between the academic project and the energetic sports culture made Boston my favourite city that I have visited.

**题目切换：**

- **EV07 现场体育赛事：** TD Garden、Celtics、观众随攻防切换口号。
- **EV11 早起：** 平时 9 点、当天 7 点、分工、poster、同题组第二。
- **PL06 最喜欢的城市：** MIT 学术印象与球馆活力的反差。

**事实边界：** 不猜比赛对手和比分；不编造 NeRF 平滑算法；“第二名”只是在同题小组中。

---

## R09 - Jensen Huang 与长期 AI 抱负

**覆盖：** PE02、PE12、OB02、OB14

**中文记忆链：** 第一次给自己的电脑选 GPU 时知道 NVIDIA 和 Jensen Huang - 后来通过科技新闻和 NVIDIA 发布会了解他 - 最钦佩其对 GPU、CUDA 和 AI 计算的长期判断 - 想问他如何提前识别机会并坚持投入 - 童年看 Iron Man 的 JARVIS 产生智能助手想法 - 大学初期变成认真目标：持续的内部情感状态影响记忆、判断和行动 - 已学习模型训练和 Agent 架构，并有未完成的 GitHub 项目。

**一分钟关键词：**

> first computer → choose GPU → NVIDIA → news / keynotes → GPU + CUDA + AI foresight → want to ask → JARVIS → university → persistent internal affective state → memory / judgment / action → ongoing project

**英文表达块：**

> I first learned about Jensen Huang when I was choosing a GPU for my first computer, and I later followed NVIDIA news and keynote presentations.

> What I respect most is his long-term judgment about GPU computing, CUDA, and AI before their full potential became obvious.

> My long-term ambition is to build an AI assistant with a persistent internal affective state that can influence its memory, judgment, and actions over time.

> I have studied model training and agent architecture and started a related GitHub project, but it is still ongoing.

**题目切换：**

- **PE02 钦佩的成功商人：** 长期技术判断，不以市值作为唯一证据。
- **PE12 想见的名人：** 想问如何识别并坚持长期机会。
- **OB02 长期抱负：** JARVIS 启发、大学认真化、功能目标和已做准备。
- **OB14 理想工作：** AI 研发、构建智能系统和研究智能如何产生。

**事实边界：** 不声称认识 Jensen Huang；JARVIS 只是虚构启发；GitHub 项目尚未完成。

---

## R10 - 外向的童年好友

**覆盖：** PE01、PE05、PE08

**中文记忆链：** 小学认识的好友 - 一起学习、吃饭、逛街 - 他外向，自己更内向 - 英语成绩好，不只依赖课本，也用歌曲和电影学习真实表达 - Oxford 旅行时与领队走散，他向当地老人问路并带大家回酒店 - 自己擅长数学物理，向他展示错题本，记录错题、原因和正确解法 - 他独立建立自己的错题本，成绩提高。

**一分钟关键词：**

> primary-school friend → outgoing vs reserved → English through songs / films → Oxford → separated → asks local person → hotel → my error notebook → mistake + reason + solution → grades improve

**英文表达块：**

> We have known each other since primary school, and his outgoing personality is very different from my more reserved one.

> He learns English through music and films as well as textbooks, and at Oxford he confidently asked a local person for directions when we became separated from our group.

> I showed him how I recorded wrong questions, the reasons for my mistakes, and the correct solutions; he later created his own error notebook and improved his maths and physics grades.

**题目切换：**

- **PE01 擅长新语言：** 歌曲电影学习法与 Oxford 问路。
- **PE05 最喜欢的童年朋友：** 长期关系、性格反差和共同经历。
- **PE08 从别人学技能的朋友：** 他向自己学错题本方法，角色不能颠倒。

**事实边界：** 只用英语作为新语言；Oxford 问的是回酒店的路，不是回医院。

---

## R11 - 母亲：种植、帮助邻居与环保

**覆盖：** PE03、PE07、PE09

**中文记忆链：** 母亲退休后在花园种花和薄荷 - 浇水、施肥、移植 - 让环境更好，也能放松和打发退休时间 - 邻居忙或外出时帮助照看植物、猫狗，给狗喂食和遛狗 - 教自己不要破坏公共草地和花朵 - 相似商品中优先选择可回收包装，例如牛奶包装。

**一分钟关键词：**

> mother → garden → flowers + mint → water / fertilise / transplant → relax in retirement → neighbours → plants / dogs / cats → feed / walk → public flowers → recyclable packaging

**英文表达块：**

> My mother grows flowers and herbs such as mint in her garden and regularly waters, fertilises, and transplants them.

> When neighbours are busy or away, she helps look after their plants and pets, including feeding dogs and taking them for walks.

> She taught me not to damage plants in public places and encouraged me to choose recyclable packaging whenever possible.

**题目切换：**

- **PE03 喜欢种植物的人：** 花园、日常养护、放松和退休生活。
- **PE07 经常帮助别人的邻里居民：** 替邻居照顾植物和宠物。
- **PE09 鼓励保护自然的人：** 公共花草与可回收牛奶包装。

**事实边界：** 不编具体花卉品种；包装用 `recyclable`，不是未经确认的 `reusable`。

---

## R12 - 姐姐婚礼与粉色多层蛋糕

**覆盖：** EV10、EV12、OB07

**中文记忆链：** 姐姐婚礼 - 粉色多层蛋糕 - 珍珠状糖饰 - 味道像普通蛋糕，特别之处主要是外观和场合 - 亲属祝福新人 - 切蛋糕时大家鼓掌并露出幸福笑容 - 感觉时间过得很快，希望姐姐幸福。

**一分钟关键词：**

> sister's wedding → pink multi-layer cake → pearl-like sugar decorations → relatives → blessings → cutting cake → applause → happy smiles → time passed quickly → wish her happiness

**英文表达块：**

> At my sister's wedding, there was a pink multi-layer cake decorated with small pearl-like sugar pieces.

> Its flavour was similar to an ordinary cake, but its appearance and connection to the wedding made it special.

> When the couple cut the cake, our relatives applauded and smiled, and I felt that the day passed incredibly quickly.

**题目切换：**

- **EV10 特别蛋糕：** 外观、装饰、味道与婚礼意义。
- **EV12 很多人微笑：** 亲属祝福、切蛋糕、鼓掌和幸福笑容。
- **OB07 特殊场合食物：** 婚礼蛋糕的象征与分享场景。

**事实边界：** 不编造蛋糕口味、层数或其他菜品。

---

## R13 - 塑料购物袋有偿使用规定

**覆盖：** OB01

**中文记忆链：** 《商品零售场所塑料购物袋有偿使用管理办法》 - 2008 年 6 月 1 日起实施 - 适用于超市、商场、集贸市场 - 塑料购物袋应有偿提供并明码标价 - 不得免费或变相免费 - 目的为减少不必要使用、节约资源和保护环境 - 2023 年后续办法仍要求零售经营者执行。

**一分钟关键词：**

> China → 2008 → paid plastic shopping bags → supermarkets / malls / markets → clear price → no free bags → fewer bags → reusable bags → resources + environment

**英文表达块：**

> I would like to talk about China's regulation on the paid use of plastic shopping bags.

> It requires supermarkets, shopping malls, and open markets to charge customers for plastic shopping bags instead of giving them away for free.

> The aim is to reduce unnecessary use, conserve resources, and encourage shoppers to bring reusable bags.

**题目切换：**

- **OB01 环保法律或规定：** 名称可以简化为 `the paid-use regulation for plastic shopping bags`，重点讲规则、范围和目的。

**事实边界：** 这是规定或管理办法，不必称为立法机关通过的法律；不是全面禁止所有塑料袋；食品卫生用途的部分预包装袋不在该定义内。

**官方来源：** [国家发展改革委 2008 年办法](https://www.ndrc.gov.cn/xxgk/zcfb/fzggwl/200805/t20080528_960713.html)、[商务部 2023 年办法](https://www.mofcom.gov.cn/zfxxgk/zc/gz/art/2024/art_7669e841461a4d73805e16f345e88579.html)。

---

## R14 - 曾任儿科医生的父亲

**覆盖：** PE04

**中文记忆链：** 父亲正式做过儿科医生 - 当初觉得医疗职业稳定、有社会地位，也能了解身体和健康 - 当时医生收入不高，后来离开 - 自己认为这是面对现实、为未来选择更好道路的务实决定。

**一分钟关键词：**

> father → former pediatrician → stable / respected → body and health → low pay at that time → left profession → practical decision → better future

**英文表达块：**

> My father used to work as a pediatrician because medicine seemed stable and respected and gave him useful knowledge about health.

> He later left the profession because doctors were not well paid at that time, and I think it was a practical decision for his future.

**事实边界：** 不编造医院、科室、工作年限或后来的职业；明确使用过去时。

---

## R15 - 喜欢画画的孩子（应急合成卡）

**覆盖：** PE11

**性质：** 这不是已验证的真实儿童经历，只在没有真实素材时应急使用。

**中文记忆链：** 朋友 10 岁的妹妹 - 喜欢画风景 - 随时随地画 - 外出时看到路边花朵并素描 - 现实中只开一朵，画中加入想象花朵和装饰，让构图更平衡 - 画画帮助放松、观察生活和表达想象。

**一分钟关键词：**

> friend's younger sister → ten → landscapes → roadside flower → quick sketch → one real bloom → imagined flowers → balanced picture → relax → observe → creativity

**英文表达块：**

> During an outing, she noticed a flower by the roadside and made a quick sketch of it.

> Instead of copying it exactly, she added a few imagined flowers and decorative details to make the composition more balanced.

> Drawing helps her relax and pay closer attention to ordinary details in daily life.

**事实边界：** 不把这张卡混入真实 Core Story，不扩展家庭背景，也不添加第二个场景。

---

## R16 - 电脑黑屏后重装系统

**覆盖：** EV04

**中文记忆链：** 启动画面正常，进入系统时黑屏 - 最初以为普通故障 - 重启两次无效后烦躁焦虑 - 调出命令行/恢复终端，但不记得命令 - 用另一台电脑制作启动 U 盘 - 自己重装系统 - 黑屏消失，电脑恢复正常。

**一分钟关键词：**

> startup screen → black when entering system → restart twice → annoyed / anxious → recovery terminal → another computer → bootable USB → reinstall → normal again

**英文表达块：**

> The normal startup screen appeared, but the display went black when the computer tried to enter the operating system.

> After two failed restarts, I used another computer to create a bootable USB drive and reinstalled the system myself.

> The problem disappeared after the reinstallation, although I never identified the exact cause.

**事实边界：** 不编造终端命令、BIOS 设置、故障原因或数据丢失；这件事不够复杂，不用于 EV05。

---

## R17 - 《工程与法律》课堂禁用手机

**覆盖：** EV19

**中文记忆链：** 大学《工程与法律》课 - 老师严禁课堂用手机 - 被发现会扣平时分 - 亲眼看到同学看手机，老师没收并让助教记名 - 自己把手机放进书包 - 认为规则合理，因为手机影响学生注意力，也影响老师授课热情。

**一分钟关键词：**

> Engineering and Law → strict phone ban → participation marks → classmate checks phone → confiscated → TA records name → my phone in bag → concentration / teacher

**英文表达块：**

> In an Engineering and Law course, our teacher strictly prohibited mobile-phone use during class.

> I saw a classmate's phone being confiscated while the teaching assistant recorded the student's name, so I kept my own phone in my bag.

> I considered the rule reasonable because phones can reduce students' concentration and discourage the teacher.

**事实边界：** 自己的手机没有被没收；不编具体扣分数额。

---

## R18 - 组织混乱的班级音乐会

**覆盖：** EV15

**中文记忆链：** 班级在教室举办普通音乐会 - 自己是观众 - 节目之间间隔很久，组织不连贯 - 有些演唱者记不住歌词，依赖原唱和屏幕歌词 - 感到恼怒、浪费时间、不被尊重 - 因为是班级活动仍留到结束，也能理解业余活动会犯错。

**一分钟关键词：**

> class concert → classroom → audience → long gaps → disorganised → forget lyrics → original recording + screen → annoyed → wasted time → stayed → amateur event

**英文表达块：**

> The class concert took place in a classroom, and I attended as an audience member.

> Long gaps between performances made the programme feel disorganised, and some singers relied on the original recordings and lyrics displayed on a screen.

> I felt that my time was being wasted, but I stayed until the end because it was an amateur event organised by my class.

**事实边界：** 不说所有演出者都没准备；不用 `teleprompter`；自己没有中途离场。

---

## R19 - 海南自行车环岛计划

**覆盖：** EV16

**中文记忆链：** 经常去海南但没骑车环岛 - 朋友完成过并强烈推荐 - 想独自骑行 - 自行车比汽车自由，可随时停下看风景 - 最期待海上日出和日落 - 需要自行车、背包和装备 - 最大挑战是从未尝试过的长距离体能 - 完成后会是挑战自我和难忘经历。

**一分钟关键词：**

> Hainan → visited often → friend recommends → future solo ride → bicycle freedom → coastline → sunrise / sunset → equipment + backpack → endurance → challenge myself

**英文表达块：**

> A friend who had cycled around Hainan strongly recommended the journey to me.

> I prefer a bicycle because it would let me stop whenever I wanted to watch the scenery, especially the sunrise and sunset over the sea.

> The biggest challenge would be physical endurance because I have never attempted such a long ride.

**事实边界：** 这是未来计划；不编路线、距离、日期或训练计划；朋友只负责推荐，不一定同行。

---

## R20 - 《犟龟》与坚持完成 3D 打印

**覆盖：** OB04

**中文记忆链：** 小学自己读 Michael Ende 的《犟龟》 - 童年具体情节记忆模糊，但“坚持”一直影响自己 - 作者官网梗概：乌龟 Tranquilla 为参加 Leo XXVIII 的婚礼出发，动物嘲笑它太慢，它数月、数年一步步前进，最后抵达草地，那里正在举行 Leo XXIX 的婚礼 - 大学小车建模时零件对不上，反复约 1 mm 微调和重打，多次想放弃，最后机械结构成功组装且小车具备基本运行能力；完整循迹、避障和 PID 最终测试没有完全成功。

**一分钟关键词：**

> primary school → The Persistent Tortoise → lion's wedding → laughed at → step by step → months and years → another wedding → persistence → 3D parts → 1 mm adjustments → reprint → car runs

**英文表达块：**

> I read *The Persistent Tortoise* by myself in primary school, and its message about persistence has stayed with me.

> The tortoise sets out for a lion's wedding, continues step by step despite being laughed at, and eventually reaches another wedding after a very long journey.

> Years later, that lesson helped me keep adjusting and reprinting a 3D car model until the mechanical parts fitted together and the car could perform basic movement.

**事实边界：** 详细情节来自作者官网复习，不冒充自己完整的童年记忆；小车项目不是书中内容。机械组装和基本运行成功，但完整循迹、避障和 PID 最终测试没有完全成功。

**来源：** [Michael Ende 官方图书页](https://michaelende.de/en/book/tranquilla-trampletrue-0)。

---

## R21 - 想购买的 32 GB MacBook Pro

**覆盖：** OB12

**中文记忆链：** 想买新款 MacBook Pro，32 GB 内存 - 还没购买，正在等新款发布 - 当前电脑多开网页和 App 会卡 - 想本地运行更多可选的小模型，也能同时开多个工具 - 选择 MacBook Pro 因为轻便，教室、实验室、图书馆和旅行都可携带 - 没有指定芯片、尺寸、价格或具体项目。

**一分钟关键词：**

> new MacBook Pro → 32 GB memory → not owned → waiting for next model → local small models → many apps / tabs → less slowdown → portable → class / lab / library / travel

**英文表达块：**

> I would like to own a new MacBook Pro with 32 gigabytes of memory, but I am waiting for the next model before deciding whether to buy it.

> The extra memory would let me run a wider range of small AI models locally and keep more applications and browser tabs open without as much slowdown.

> I prefer a laptop because I could carry it to classrooms, laboratories, libraries, and while travelling.

**事实边界：** 尚未拥有；不编芯片、屏幕、价格、发布时间或指定模型项目。

---

## R22 - 不想长期居住的朋友公寓

**覆盖：** PL03

**中文记忆链：** 约好去朋友公寓玩 NBA 2K、FIFA 等游戏 - 朋友父母和弟弟也在 - 与其他亲属不熟，不知道聊什么，也担心打扰 - 桌面和地上散落弟弟玩具，显得杂乱 - 当天玩得开心，但不适合自己长期居住。

**一分钟关键词：**

> friend's apartment → invited to play games → NBA 2K / FIFA → parents + younger brother → unfamiliar / awkward → worry about disturbing → toys on desk and floor → enjoyable visit → would not live there

**英文表达块：**

> I visited my friend's apartment because we had arranged to play games such as NBA 2K and FIFA.

> His parents and younger brother were also there, and I felt slightly awkward because I did not know them well and worried about disturbing the family.

> Toys were scattered across the desk and floor, so although I enjoyed the visit, I would not want to live there permanently.

**事实边界：** 不把拘谨说成家庭不友好；拜访本身是开心的，结论只针对长期居住。

---

## R23 - 家中最放松的地方：床

**覆盖：** PL09

**中文记忆链：** 家里最喜欢在床上放松 - 周末上午和晚上睡前 - 躺着看手机、玩游戏、刷短视频 - 躺姿比坐着轻松，床更柔软，周围灯光比其他地方柔和 - 能减轻压力并更容易入睡。

**一分钟关键词：**

> bed → weekend mornings / before sleep → phone → games / short videos → lying down → soft → gentle lighting → less stress → easier sleep

**英文表达块：**

> My favourite place to relax at home is my bed, especially on weekend mornings and before I go to sleep.

> I usually lie down, use my phone, play games, or watch short videos because it feels much more comfortable than sitting.

> The soft bed and gentler lighting help reduce my stress and make it easier for me to fall asleep.

**事实边界：** 重点是床带来的舒适与放松，不把手机本身变成地点题中心。
notes.body:
# IELTS Speaking Part 2 可复习资料库

这是 Part 2 的成品复习入口，不是素材收集台账。完整原题及中英翻译见 [2026 年 5-8 月 Part 2 题库与素材分类](./2026-may-august-part-2-topic-clusters.md)，详细事实来源见 [Part 2 Knowledge Bank](./part-2-knowledge-bank.md)。

- 覆盖全部 `55` 道题。
- `54` 道题使用真实经历或经可靠来源核对的材料。
- `PE11` 没有真实儿童素材，保留为明确标记的应急合成卡。
- 所有题目目前均为“内容就绪”，尚未完成两分钟口述验证；不能把内容就绪等同于考试就绪。
- 不背整篇答案。先用中文记忆链恢复事实，再用英文表达块组织自己的答案。

## 复习方法

1. 一分钟准备时，只看“关键词”和对应题目的“切换重点”。
2. 口述时按“背景 - 具体场景 - 结果 - 感受”展开，不要求逐字复现英文表达块。
3. 结束后检查“事实边界”，避免把不同时间线、人物角色或完成状态混在一起。

## 快速索引

| --- | --- | --- |
| R01 | 姚顺雨访谈、主动学习与 ChatGPT | EV06、EV08、OB03、OB05、OB08、OB13 |
| R02 | 四人循迹小车项目 | PE06、PE10、EV03、EV05、EV09、EV13、EV14 |
| R03 | Spider-Man 宣传片与朋友观影 | EV01、OB06、OB11 |
| R04 | 二手湖与低成本露营 | EV02、OB09、PL01、PL02、PL04 |
| R05 | 姐姐的两次教育选择 | EV17、EV18 |
| R06 | 仁和新城商业综合体 | PL05、PL07、PL08 |
| R07 | 256 GB 改买 512 GB 手机 | OB10、OB15 |

## R02 - 四人循迹小车项目

**覆盖：** PE06、PE10、EV03、EV05、EV09、EV13、EV14

**中文记忆链：** 上学期四人团队从零制作循迹避障小车 - 分工为传感器板、控制板/PID、实验记录、自己的 3D 建模打印与组装 - 负责人制定计划、截止时间和任务 - 两块 PCB 无法连接时提出增加中间接口板 - 控制板布局太紧凑导致多次焊接失败，自己用证据说服队友重做 - 电路延迟压缩测试时间，机械间隙和 PID 调参不足，最终测试没有完全成功 - 学到集成和测试不能留到最后。

**一分钟关键词：**

> last term → four people → line-following car → four roles → my 3D print / assembly → interface board → compact PCB → redesign → delay → little PID testing → final test → integration lesson

**英文表达块：**

> We worked in a four-person team to build a small line-following car, and my main responsibility was designing and 3D-printing the structure and assembling the components.

> When the sensor board and control board could not be connected directly, one teammate suggested adding a small interface board, and the solution worked.

> I also persuaded another teammate to redesign a PCB because its layout was too compact and had caused repeated soldering failures.

> The final test did not fully succeed because circuit delays left too little time for mechanical testing and PID tuning, but it taught me the importance of integration.

**题目切换：**

- **PE06 巧妙解决问题的人：** 只讲提出接口板的项目负责人。
- **PE10 经常制定计划的人：** 讲分工、截止时间、四项任务及遇到新问题后调整方案。
- **EV03 很久才回复消息：** 截止前约六天忙于项目，母亲日常问候几天未回，后来道歉并解释。
- **EV05 技术难题：** 讲电路延迟、低底盘间隙、PID 时间不足和集成失败。
- **EV09 团队合作：** 讲四人分工、相互依赖和最终教训。
- **EV13 劝别人做不愿做的事：** 讲队友因沉没成本拒绝重做 PCB，自己用失败证据说服他。
- **EV14 发挥想象力：** 讲没有现成结构，自己建模、打印、排列和组装部件。

**事实边界：** 整体最终测试没有完全成功；接口板和重新设计控制板分别解决了局部问题。不要把两者说成同一位队友或同一问题。

## R13 - 塑料购物袋有偿使用规定

**覆盖：** OB01

**中文记忆链：** 《商品零售场所塑料购物袋有偿使用管理办法》 - 2008 年 6 月 1 日起实施 - 适用于超市、商场、集贸市场 - 塑料购物袋应有偿提供并明码标价 - 不得免费或变相免费 - 目的为减少不必要使用、节约资源和保护环境 - 2023 年后续办法仍要求零售经营者执行。

**一分钟关键词：**

> China → 2008 → paid plastic shopping bags → supermarkets / malls / markets → clear price → no free bags → fewer bags → reusable bags → resources + environment

**英文表达块：**

> I would like to talk about China's regulation on the paid use of plastic shopping bags.

> It requires supermarkets, shopping malls, and open markets to charge customers for plastic shopping bags instead of giving them away for free.

> The aim is to reduce unnecessary use, conserve resources, and encourage shoppers to bring reusable bags.

**题目切换：**

- **OB01 环保法律或规定：** 名称可以简化为 `the paid-use regulation for plastic shopping bags`，重点讲规则、范围和目的。

**事实边界：** 这是规定或管理办法，不必称为立法机关通过的法律；不是全面禁止所有塑料袋；食品卫生用途的部分预包装袋不在该定义内。

**官方来源：** [国家发展改革委 2008 年办法](https://www.ndrc.gov.cn/xxgk/zcfb/fzggwl/200805/t20080528_960713.html)、[商务部 2023 年办法](https://www.mofcom.gov.cn/zfxxgk/zc/gz/art/2024/art_7669e841461a4d73805e16f345e88579.html)。

---

## R14 - 曾任儿科医生的父亲

**覆盖：** PE04

**中文记忆链：** 父亲正式做过儿科医生 - 当初觉得医疗职业稳定、有社会地位，也能了解身体和健康 - 当时医生收入不高，后来离开 - 自己认为这是面对现实、为未来选择更好道路的务实决定。

**一分钟关键词：**

> father → former pediatrician → stable / respected → body and health → low pay at that time → left profession → practical decision → better future

**英文表达块：**

> My father used to work as a pediatrician because medicine seemed stable and respected and gave him useful knowledge about health.

> He later left the profession because doctors were not well paid at that time, and I think it was a practical decision for his future.

**事实边界：** 不编造医院、科室、工作年限或后来的职业；明确使用过去时。

---

## R15 - 喜欢画画的孩子（应急合成卡）

**覆盖：** PE11

**性质：** 这不是已验证的真实儿童经历，只在没有真实素材时应急使用。

**中文记忆链：** 朋友 10 岁的妹妹 - 喜欢画风景 - 随时随地画 - 外出时看到路边花朵并素描 - 现实中只开一朵，画中加入想象花朵和装饰，让构图更平衡 - 画画帮助放松、观察生活和表达想象。

**一分钟关键词：**

> friend's younger sister → ten → landscapes → roadside flower → quick sketch → one real bloom → imagined flowers → balanced picture → relax → observe → creativity

**英文表达块：**

> During an outing, she noticed a flower by the roadside and made a quick sketch of it.

> Instead of copying it exactly, she added a few imagined flowers and decorative details to make the composition more balanced.

> Drawing helps her relax and pay closer attention to ordinary details in daily life.

**事实边界：** 不把这张卡混入真实 Core Story，不扩展家庭背景，也不添加第二个场景。

---

## R16 - 电脑黑屏后重装系统

**覆盖：** EV04

**中文记忆链：** 启动画面正常，进入系统时黑屏 - 最初以为普通故障 - 重启两次无效后烦躁焦虑 - 调出命令行/恢复终端，但不记得命令 - 用另一台电脑制作启动 U 盘 - 自己重装系统 - 黑屏消失，电脑恢复正常。

**一分钟关键词：**

> startup screen → black when entering system → restart twice → annoyed / anxious → recovery terminal → another computer → bootable USB → reinstall → normal again

**英文表达块：**

> The normal startup screen appeared, but the display went black when the computer tried to enter the operating system.

> After two failed restarts, I used another computer to create a bootable USB drive and reinstalled the system myself.

> The problem disappeared after the reinstallation, although I never identified the exact cause.

**事实边界：** 不编造终端命令、BIOS 设置、故障原因或数据丢失；这件事不够复杂，不用于 EV05。

---

## R17 - 《工程与法律》课堂禁用手机

**覆盖：** EV19

**中文记忆链：** 大学《工程与法律》课 - 老师严禁课堂用手机 - 被发现会扣平时分 - 亲眼看到同学看手机，老师没收并让助教记名 - 自己把手机放进书包 - 认为规则合理，因为手机影响学生注意力，也影响老师授课热情。

**一分钟关键词：**

> Engineering and Law → strict phone ban → participation marks → classmate checks phone → confiscated → TA records name → my phone in bag → concentration / teacher

**英文表达块：**

> In an Engineering and Law course, our teacher strictly prohibited mobile-phone use during class.

> I saw a classmate's phone being confiscated while the teaching assistant recorded the student's name, so I kept my own phone in my bag.

> I considered the rule reasonable because phones can reduce students' concentration and discourage the teacher.

**事实边界：** 自己的手机没有被没收；不编具体扣分数额。

---

## R18 - 组织混乱的班级音乐会

**覆盖：** EV15

**中文记忆链：** 班级在教室举办普通音乐会 - 自己是观众 - 节目之间间隔很久，组织不连贯 - 有些演唱者记不住歌词，依赖原唱和屏幕歌词 - 感到恼怒、浪费时间、不被尊重 - 因为是班级活动仍留到结束，也能理解业余活动会犯错。

**一分钟关键词：**

> class concert → classroom → audience → long gaps → disorganised → forget lyrics → original recording + screen → annoyed → wasted time → stayed → amateur event

**英文表达块：**

> The class concert took place in a classroom, and I attended as an audience member.

> Long gaps between performances made the programme feel disorganised, and some singers relied on the original recordings and lyrics displayed on a screen.

> I felt that my time was being wasted, but I stayed until the end because it was an amateur event organised by my class.

**事实边界：** 不说所有演出者都没准备；不用 `teleprompter`；自己没有中途离场。

---

## R19 - 海南自行车环岛计划

**覆盖：** EV16

**中文记忆链：** 经常去海南但没骑车环岛 - 朋友完成过并强烈推荐 - 想独自骑行 - 自行车比汽车自由，可随时停下看风景 - 最期待海上日出和日落 - 需要自行车、背包和装备 - 最大挑战是从未尝试过的长距离体能 - 完成后会是挑战自我和难忘经历。

**一分钟关键词：**

> Hainan → visited often → friend recommends → future solo ride → bicycle freedom → coastline → sunrise / sunset → equipment + backpack → endurance → challenge myself

**英文表达块：**

> A friend who had cycled around Hainan strongly recommended the journey to me.

> I prefer a bicycle because it would let me stop whenever I wanted to watch the scenery, especially the sunrise and sunset over the sea.

> The biggest challenge would be physical endurance because I have never attempted such a long ride.

**事实边界：** 这是未来计划；不编路线、距离、日期或训练计划；朋友只负责推荐，不一定同行。

---

## R20 - 《犟龟》与坚持完成 3D 打印

**覆盖：** OB04

**中文记忆链：** 小学自己读 Michael Ende 的《犟龟》 - 童年具体情节记忆模糊，但“坚持”一直影响自己 - 作者官网梗概：乌龟 Tranquilla 为参加 Leo XXVIII 的婚礼出发，动物嘲笑它太慢，它数月、数年一步步前进，最后抵达草地，那里正在举行 Leo XXIX 的婚礼 - 大学小车建模时零件对不上，反复约 1 mm 微调和重打，多次想放弃，最后机械结构成功组装且小车具备基本运行能力；完整循迹、避障和 PID 最终测试没有完全成功。

**一分钟关键词：**

> primary school → The Persistent Tortoise → lion's wedding → laughed at → step by step → months and years → another wedding → persistence → 3D parts → 1 mm adjustments → reprint → car runs

**英文表达块：**

> I read *The Persistent Tortoise* by myself in primary school, and its message about persistence has stayed with me.

> The tortoise sets out for a lion's wedding, continues step by step despite being laughed at, and eventually reaches another wedding after a very long journey.

> Years later, that lesson helped me keep adjusting and reprinting a 3D car model until the mechanical parts fitted together and the car could perform basic movement.

**事实边界：** 详细情节来自作者官网复习，不冒充自己完整的童年记忆；小车项目不是书中内容。机械组装和基本运行成功，但完整循迹、避障和 PID 最终测试没有完全成功。

**来源：** [Michael Ende 官方图书页](https://michaelende.de/en/book/tranquilla-trampletrue-0)。

---

## R21 - 想购买的 32 GB MacBook Pro

**覆盖：** OB12

**中文记忆链：** 想买新款 MacBook Pro，32 GB 内存 - 还没购买，正在等新款发布 - 当前电脑多开网页和 App 会卡 - 想本地运行更多可选的小模型，也能同时开多个工具 - 选择 MacBook Pro 因为轻便，教室、实验室、图书馆和旅行都可携带 - 没有指定芯片、尺寸、价格或具体项目。

**一分钟关键词：**

> new MacBook Pro → 32 GB memory → not owned → waiting for next model → local small models → many apps / tabs → less slowdown → portable → class / lab / library / travel

**英文表达块：**

> I would like to own a new MacBook Pro with 32 gigabytes of memory, but I am waiting for the next model before deciding whether to buy it.

> The extra memory would let me run a wider range of small AI models locally and keep more applications and browser tabs open without as much slowdown.

> I prefer a laptop because I could carry it to classrooms, laboratories, libraries, and while travelling.

**事实边界：** 尚未拥有；不编芯片、屏幕、价格、发布时间或指定模型项目。

---

## R22 - 不想长期居住的朋友公寓

**覆盖：** PL03

**中文记忆链：** 约好去朋友公寓玩 NBA 2K、FIFA 等游戏 - 朋友父母和弟弟也在 - 与其他亲属不熟，不知道聊什么，也担心打扰 - 桌面和地上散落弟弟玩具，显得杂乱 - 当天玩得开心，但不适合自己长期居住。

**一分钟关键词：**

> friend's apartment → invited to play games → NBA 2K / FIFA → parents + younger brother → unfamiliar / awkward → worry about disturbing → toys on desk and floor → enjoyable visit → would not live there

**英文表达块：**

> I visited my friend's apartment because we had arranged to play games such as NBA 2K and FIFA.

> His parents and younger brother were also there, and I felt slightly awkward because I did not know them well and worried about disturbing the family.

> Toys were scattered across the desk and floor, so although I enjoyed the visit, I would not want to live there permanently.

**事实边界：** 不把拘谨说成家庭不友好；拜访本身是开心的，结论只针对长期居住。

---

## R23 - 家中最放松的地方：床

**覆盖：** PL09

**中文记忆链：** 家里最喜欢在床上放松 - 周末上午和晚上睡前 - 躺着看手机、玩游戏、刷短视频 - 躺姿比坐着轻松，床更柔软，周围灯光比其他地方柔和 - 能减轻压力并更容易入睡。

**一分钟关键词：**

> bed → weekend mornings / before sleep → phone → games / short videos → lying down → soft → gentle lighting → less stress → easier sleep

**英文表达块：**

> My favourite place to relax at home is my bed, especially on weekend mornings and before I go to sleep.

> I usually lie down, use my phone, play games, or watch short videos because it feels much more comfortable than sitting.

> The soft bed and gentler lighting help reduce my stress and make it easier for me to fall asleep.

**事实边界：** 重点是床带来的舒适与放松，不把手机本身变成地点题中心。
notes.html:
IELTS Speaking Part 2 可复习资料库

这是 Part 2 的成品复习入口，不是素材收集台账。完整原题及中英翻译见 2026 年 5-8 月 Part 2 题库与素材分类，详细事实来源见 Part 2 Knowledge Bank。

  • 覆盖全部 55 道题。
  • 54 道题使用真实经历或经可靠来源核对的材料。
  • PE11 没有真实儿童素材，保留为明确标记的应急合成卡。
  • 所有题目目前均为“内容就绪”，尚未完成两分钟口述验证；不能把内容就绪等同于考试就绪。
  • 不背整篇答案。先用中文记忆链恢复事实，再用英文表达块组织自己的答案。

复习方法

  1. 一分钟准备时，只看“关键词”和对应题目的“切换重点”。
  2. 口述时按“背景 - 具体场景 - 结果 - 感受”展开，不要求逐字复现英文表达块。
  3. 结束后检查“事实边界”，避免把不同时间线、人物角色或完成状态混在一起。

R01 - 从等待机会到主动行动

覆盖： EV06、EV08、OB03、OB05、OB08、OB13

中文记忆链： 大三末以前较被动，认为机会主要靠运气 - 6 月在 Bilibili 看约一小时的姚顺雨访谈 - 他从物理本科走向 AI 研究并主动学习、投递简历 - 意识到行动能创造选择 - 改变 IELTS 学习方式，主动用 ChatGPT 练口语、追问、纠错和整理素材 - 固定日计划两天才能完成，于是改成可顺延的优先级计划。

一分钟关键词：

third year → passive → Shunyu Yao interview → physics to AI → keep learning / send CV → take initiative → ChatGPT → speaking practice → flexible priority plan

英文表达块：

I used to believe that good opportunities depended mainly on luck, so I often waited instead of taking action.

A one-hour interview with research scientist Shunyu Yao changed my view because he kept learning and applying for opportunities rather than waiting for ideal conditions.

I then began using ChatGPT actively for speaking practice, follow-up questions, corrections, and organising my Part 2 material.

When one planned day of IELTS work started taking almost two actual days, I replaced the fixed schedule with a flexible, priority-based plan.

题目切换：

  • EV06 重要决定： 突出“不再等待，主动创造选择”。
  • EV08 改变计划： 突出固定日程过量、任务可顺延、口语优先。
  • OB03 外语学习工具： 突出实时口语、解释、纠错和主动提取。
  • OB05 网络节目： 突出 6 月、Bilibili、约一小时、物理转 AI、AI 未来观点。
  • OB08 有趣视频： 突出“主动学习和投简历”改变了自己的想法。
  • OB13 程序或应用： 突出 ChatGPT 在电脑或手机上的个性化学习用途。

事实边界： 不编造访谈节目名称；不声称新计划已带来最终分数提升。

R02 - 四人循迹小车项目

覆盖： PE06、PE10、EV03、EV05、EV09、EV13、EV14

中文记忆链： 上学期四人团队从零制作循迹避障小车 - 分工为传感器板、控制板/PID、实验记录、自己的 3D 建模打印与组装 - 负责人制定计划、截止时间和任务 - 两块 PCB 无法连接时提出增加中间接口板 - 控制板布局太紧凑导致多次焊接失败，自己用证据说服队友重做 - 电路延迟压缩测试时间，机械间隙和 PID 调参不足，最终测试没有完全成功 - 学到集成和测试不能留到最后。

一分钟关键词：

last term → four people → line-following car → four roles → my 3D print / assembly → interface board → compact PCB → redesign → delay → little PID testing → final test → integration lesson

英文表达块：

We worked in a four-person team to build a small line-following car, and my main responsibility was designing and 3D-printing the structure and assembling the components.

When the sensor board and control board could not be connected directly, one teammate suggested adding a small interface board, and the solution worked.

I also persuaded another teammate to redesign a PCB because its layout was too compact and had caused repeated soldering failures.

The final test did not fully succeed because circuit delays left too little time for mechanical testing and PID tuning, but it taught me the importance of integration.

题目切换：

  • PE06 巧妙解决问题的人： 只讲提出接口板的项目负责人。
  • PE10 经常制定计划的人： 讲分工、截止时间、四项任务及遇到新问题后调整方案。
  • EV03 很久才回复消息： 截止前约六天忙于项目，母亲日常问候几天未回，后来道歉并解释。
  • EV05 技术难题： 讲电路延迟、低底盘间隙、PID 时间不足和集成失败。
  • EV09 团队合作： 讲四人分工、相互依赖和最终教训。
  • EV13 劝别人做不愿做的事： 讲队友因沉没成本拒绝重做 PCB，自己用失败证据说服他。
  • EV14 发挥想象力： 讲没有现成结构，自己建模、打印、排列和组装部件。

事实边界： 整体最终测试没有完全成功；接口板和重新设计控制板分别解决了局部问题。不要把两者说成同一位队友或同一问题。

R03 - Spider-Man 宣传片与朋友观影

覆盖： EV01、OB06、OB11

中文记忆链： 很久没见朋友 - 都喜欢 Marvel - 6 月在 Bilibili 看到官方宣传片 - Spider-Man 搂着 Messi 荡蛛丝，Messi 表情僵硬，网友调侃演技 - 觉得好笑并更期待电影 - 上映后与朋友约好一起看，自己负责订票 - 看完讨论角色、评分和未来电影 - 借电影重新联系。

一分钟关键词：

long time no see → Marvel fans → June / Bilibili → Messi + Spider-Man → web swinging → stiff expression → funny → booked tickets → cinema → discussion → reconnect

英文表达块：

Since we had not seen each other in ages, we arranged to watch Spider-Man: Brand New Day together, and I booked the tickets.

The funniest promotional scene showed Spider-Man holding Messi while they swung between buildings on a web, and many viewers joked about Messi's stiff expression.

After the film, we compared our opinions and talked about future Marvel movies, which reminded me how much I had missed spending time with them.

题目切换：

  • EV01 组织的开心活动： 协调观影、负责订票、朋友参加、重新联系。
  • OB06 名人广告： 只讲 6 月宣传片、Messi、蛛丝摆荡、网友反应和自己的期待。
  • OB11 最近看的电影： 讲共同兴趣、观影和看完后的讨论。

事实边界： Messi 只出现在宣传片中，不能说他出演了电影；不把普通观影编成生日或大型派对。

R04 - 二手湖：环境变化与低成本露营

覆盖： EV02、OB09、PL01、PL02、PL04

I would introduce clearer fines for littering around lakes and stronger rules to protect fish and the wider ecosystem.
